_comment: The bundled drivers in this directory are the drivers this Core release
ships. Every release carries them, so `ftw update` and `ftw rollback` move
them with Core and a gateway boots and runs offline. They are generated
from srcfl/device-drivers at the commit pinned here, and CI fails if they
drift from it. Editing a .lua file in this directory is not a way to
change a driver -- fix it in device-drivers and move the pin.
The snapshot comes from that repository's source, not from its signed
channel. A channel artifact keeps its control path only when the catalog
marks the driver control: true; every other one is write-inert.
Which drivers are bundled is FTW's choice and is the list below.
device-drivers publishes more than these; an owner can install others
from the signed channel. Run scripts/sync-bundled-drivers.sh to update.
